entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Static web assets from a NuGet package are not compressed on their fingerprinted route (project references are) #56648
  • Optimized AOT publish (#54515) leaves out ResolveReferences before PrepareResources, so BeforeTargets="ResolveReferences" resource targets are skipped #56645
  • Native companion asset declaration and transitive content flow for file-based C# apps ('#:ref') #56642
  • Unify dependency referencing under '#:include' with optional call-site isolation ('As=Library') #56641
  • CA2000 false positive when a disposable is passed to a primary constructor and stored #56639

Closed

  • `launchSettings.json` environment variables are not propagated for `commandName: Executable` #56023
  • dnx doesn't fall back to local cache when network is unavailable #50579
  • NativeAOT for Android and iOS is using the wrong ILC and runtime pack #56479
  • Local build failure: error CS0579: Duplicate TargetFrameworkAttribute #27749
    Discussion
  • dotnet test (VSTest) shows no test results when stdout is a terminal in SDK 11 RC1 #56445
  • Revalidate references to microsoft/testfx#5533 #56595
